name: R_J_molK
description: Ideal gas constant
source: CODATA 2018

name: M_H2O_kg_mol
description: Molar mass of water
source: IUPAC

name: T_min_K
description: Lowest temperature of the GSTA/LDF data (200 degC); also lowest for Sips
source: van Kampen et al.; Adsorption 2021; 27; 577-589 (abstract)

name: T_max_K
description: Highest temperature of the GSTA/LDF data (350 degC)
source: van Kampen et al.; Adsorption 2021; 27; 577-589 (abstract)

name: T_max_sips_K
description: Highest temperature of the Sips fit data (breakthroughs at 200 and 250 degC only)
source: van Kampen et al.; React. Chem. Eng. 2021; Fig. 3 caption

name: p_min_bar
description: Lowest H2O partial pressure of the data
source: van Kampen et al.; Adsorption 2021; 27; 577-589 (abstract)

name: p_max_bar
description: Highest H2O partial pressure of the data
source: van Kampen et al.; Adsorption 2021; 27; 577-589 (abstract)

name: sips_qs_kgkg
description: Sips saturation capacity (pellet basis; WORKING capacity after regeneration so feed loading = 0)
source: van Kampen et al.; React. Chem. Eng. 2021; 6; 244-257; Table 3

name: sips_b0_1_bar
description: Sips affinity pre-exponential factor
source: van Kampen et al.; React. Chem. Eng. 2021; 6; 244-257; Table 3

name: sips_Ea_J_mol
description: Sips affinity energy; b = b0*exp(-Ea/(R*T)) so b rises as T falls
source: van Kampen et al.; React. Chem. Eng. 2021; 6; 244-257; Table 3 and Eq. 18

name: sips_n
description: Sips heterogeneity exponent; q = qs*(b*p)^(1/n)/(1+(b*p)^(1/n))
source: van Kampen et al.; React. Chem. Eng. 2021; 6; 244-257; Table 3 and Eq. 17

name: gsta_qs_kgkg
description: Maximum capacity of the zeolite crystal (25.5 wt.%; fixed in fit)
source: van Kampen et al.; Adsorption 2021; Tables 1 and 3

name: gsta_f
description: Crystal fraction of the pellet (20 wt.% binder)
source: van Kampen et al.; Adsorption 2021; Table 3 and Eq. 9

name: gsta_m
description: Number of GSTA sites (dual-site)
source: van Kampen et al.; Adsorption 2021; Table 3

name: gsta_P0_bar
description: Standard pressure P0 in K_n*(p/P0)^n (assumed 1 bar; reproduces the team check values)
source: van Kampen et al.; Adsorption 2021; Eq. 2 (value of P0 assumed)

name: gsta_dH1_J_mol
description: Standard enthalpy of GSTA site 1 (+/- 3.1 kJ/mol)
source: van Kampen et al.; Adsorption 2021; Table 3

name: gsta_dS1_J_molK
description: Standard entropy of GSTA site 1 (+/- 5 J/mol/K)
source: van Kampen et al.; Adsorption 2021; Table 3

name: gsta_dH2_J_mol
description: Standard enthalpy of GSTA site 2 (+/- 31.0 kJ/mol)
source: van Kampen et al.; Adsorption 2021; Table 3

name: gsta_dS2_J_molK
description: Standard entropy of GSTA site 2 (+/- 52 J/mol/K)
source: van Kampen et al.; Adsorption 2021; Table 3

name: cap_muRT_mol_kg_T473.15
description: Capillary condensation parameter mu/(R*T) at 473.15 K (UNIT IS mol/kg)
source: van Kampen et al.; Adsorption 2021; Table 4

name: cap_muRT_mol_kg_T523.15
description: Capillary condensation parameter mu/(R*T) at 523.15 K (UNIT IS mol/kg)
source: van Kampen et al.; Adsorption 2021; Table 4

name: cap_muRT_mol_kg_T573.15
description: Capillary condensation parameter mu/(R*T) at 573.15 K (UNIT IS mol/kg)
source: van Kampen et al.; Adsorption 2021; Table 4

name: cap_muRT_mol_kg_T623.15
description: Capillary condensation parameter mu/(R*T) at 623.15 K (UNIT IS mol/kg)
source: van Kampen et al.; Adsorption 2021; Table 4

name: ldf_D0c_m2_s
description: Pre-exponential factor of corrected micropore diffusivity Dc*
source: van Kampen et al.; Adsorption 2021; Table 5 and Eq. 17

name: ldf_Ea_J_mol
description: Activation energy of micropore diffusion
source: van Kampen et al.; Adsorption 2021; Table 5

name: d_crystal_m
description: Zeolite crystal diameter (Rc = d/2)
source: van Kampen et al.; Adsorption 2021; Table 1

name: d_pellet_m
description: Pellet diameter used in the paper (web app default is 3 mm)
source: van Kampen et al.; Adsorption 2021; Table 1

name: rho_bed_kg_m3
description: Bulk (bed) density of the pellets
source: van Kampen et al.; Adsorption 2021; Table 1

name: eps_bed
description: Bed void fraction
source: van Kampen et al.; Adsorption 2021; Table 1

name: eps_pellet
description: Pellet (macropore) porosity
source: van Kampen et al.; Adsorption 2021; Table 1

name: cp_pellet_J_kgK
description: Heat capacity of the pellets (typical porous-ceramic value; NOT measured for zeolite 3A)
source: Guffanti et al.; Ind. Eng. Chem. Res. 2021; Table 4 and Section 2.2

name: dH_ads_J_mol
description: Old spec value for comparison only (default is sips_Ea_J_mol = -60.1 kJ/mol; team decision 21 Nov 2026)
source: Guffanti et al.; Ind. Eng. Chem. Res. 2021; Table 4 (citing Gabrus et al.); comparison only; default is sips_Ea_J_mol
